subject: general
question: Sonu Kumar spends 42% of his monthly salary on food, 16% on rent, 10% on entertainment and 7% on transport. But due to family program to meet the requirement of Rs.18,000, he had to take a loan of Rs. 12,500. Find his monthly salary.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total spending % = 42% + 16% + 10% + 7% = 75%

Savings % = 100% − 75% = 25%

Actual Savings = 18,000 − 12,500 = 5,500

25% of Salary = 5,500

Salary (100%) = 5,500 × 4 = 22,000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 22,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Expenditure on Food = 42%, Rent = 16%, Entertainment = 10%, Transport = 7%. Requirement = Rs. 18,000, Loan = Rs. 12,500.

Formula: Total Salary (100%) = Total Expenditure + Savings.
